summary: A witness connects an ordinary device repair to someone being able to apply for a grant.
realLife: Washington HB 1483 (2025). Senate supporters cited grant applications among the everyday activities that depend on working electronics.
inGame: needs: a grant applicant needs a device that is out for repair.
gates: A grant applicant needs a device that is out for repair.

turns.what: A borrowed machine sees the applicant through.
turns.pulledBy: A loaner arrives before the filing date.

turns.writesBack: The missed application becomes part of the constituent's account.
